Dataset provenance and limits

FAFB v783 and BANC v888 are different specimens / releases. The 336 ocellar matches identify selected FAFB neurons but are not a completed ocellar circuit, and the connection matrix here only covers the 3 ExR1 cells linked in your provided table. Uploaded SWC files provide morphology, not automatically measured synaptic connections. Root IDs are segmentation-snapshot dependent. Read Codex dataset guidance ↗.

Segmentation-to-connectivity workflow

Physical measurements

4 × 4 × 45 nm — BANC EM sampling
8 nm isotropic — MaleCNS EM sampling

Those are reported acquisition voxel dimensions from different datasets, not the scales of the images or simulations in this app.

Only annotated 3D neuron meshes or skeleton data can faithfully reproduce individual cells. A visually realistic illustration alone cannot establish connectivity.

Primary evidence / source portals

Research questions for your project

01 / Visual circuits

Dragonfly tracking vs fly optic lobes

Compare known motion-sensitive computations; avoid claiming homologous cell types without experimental mapping.

02 / Network topology

Recurrence and hub structure

Calculate weighted, directed network motifs using real edge lists, then distinguish graph predictions from recorded activity.

03 / Cross-dataset mapping

FAFB ↔ BANC ↔ MaleCNS

Use validated cross-dataset matches and snapshot-specific IDs instead of assuming ID equivalence.
